status.off: Saving to your account is off.
status.signedOut: Your data is saved on this device only. Sign in to keep it in your account and use it on other devices.
status.offline: Couldn't reach your account. Your changes are safe on this device and will be saved when you're back online.
status.conflict: This device and your account have different data. Choose which to keep above.
status.tooLarge: Your data is over the 2 MB that an account can hold, so it is saved on this device only. Download it from below to keep a copy.

restore.label: Restore from a downloaded file
restore.confirm: Replace the data on this device with the file from {{date}} ({{count}} items)? You can undo this afterwards.

error.not_json: That file can't be read. Choose a file downloaded from Gylio.
error.not_gylio: That file isn't Gylio data. Choose a file downloaded from Gylio.

conflict.title: Which data should Gylio keep?
conflict.body: Your account has data saved on {{date}}, and this device has different data.
conflict.undoHint: Using your account's data keeps this device's data as a backup you can restore from Settings.

signOut.heading: Sign out
signOut.intro: Signing out keeps your data on this device, so it's here when you sign in again, even offline. On a shared or borrowed device, remove it instead.
signOut.remove: Sign out and remove my data from this device
signOut.menu: Remove my data from this device
signOut.confirmTitle: Remove your data from this device?
signOut.synced: Your tasks, calendar events, budgets, transactions and debts are kept in your account and come back when you sign in. Tracked time, routines, rewards and social plans are kept only on this device and will be gone.
signOut.pending_one: 1 change hasn't reached your account yet and will be gone.
signOut.pending_other: {{count}} changes haven't reached your account yet and will be gone.
signOut.savedCopy: Your account has a copy saved {{when}}. Anything you changed after that will be gone.
signOut.deviceOnly: Your data is kept only on this device, so it can't be brought back after this.
signOut.staysHere: Your theme, language and accessibility settings stay on this device.
signOut.downloadHint: If you might want it later, download a copy first.
signOut.failed: Couldn't sign out, so nothing was removed. Check your connection and try again.
